description.en: Attaches a reaction icon/emote (e.g. surprise, sweat drop) above a character, identified by name.
Character handle to show the icon on.
Name of the icon/emote to display.
An integer handle for the created icon (0 if the target character doesn't exist); null only if the call itself was invalid (fewer than 2 arguments).

example.code:
// Show a reaction icon above a character
CMND_SET_ICON_TO_CHARA(hHayamiL, "\x0083K\x0081[\x0083\x009301");
